Format-ratio extrapolation applies observed byte-savings ratios to inventory
bytes; unsampled formats use an explicitly marked overall-ratio fallback.
Estimates are not guaranteed savings or confidence bounds. Small samples and
gallery variation can change outcomes.
Failed trials retain originals; larger candidates are retained only when
explicitly allowed. Unchanged excludes failures; cached counts overlap outcomes.
Mean SSIM includes unchanged originals and can hide individual poor results.
Lossless means pixel preservation, not identical file bytes.
Trial rates include failures and cache reuse; they are not encoder speed.
Reserved memory is an estimate, not process RAM.
Inspect full-resolution previews (-O) before lossy writes. Increase sampling to
refine estimates; -U refresh updates inventory membership.
